I have been farming here in the North Central for many years, and since this rented plot is almost a full hectare, it is worth putting some money into fertilizer so I do not waste the season. I will use my own kept seed because the agro-dealer does not always have the right type for this crop, and I have to watch my costs carefully. My children and I will handle most of the work, but when the weeds come up thick I will hire a few day laborers to help us finish on time.
